statement: Pinned Dolphin's Nunchuk emulator exposes a 16-byte extension calibration block at register 0xA40020: three accelerometer zero-g axes and an extra byte, three one-g axes and another byte, joystick X/Y max/min/center triplets (six bytes), and two trailing checksums. The template's physical accuracy is untested.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Extension.h 70-91 register layout; Nunchuk.cpp 107-143. Source-emulator register representation, not real calibration data.
